Catalogue Photo Manager

One photo manager: import extracted AQB Studio folders, upload or replace one service photo, and review before publication.

Search by service name, category, synonym or natural wording. Example: retie finds Retightening services.
Select a service.
JPG, PNG or WebP, maximum 10 MB.
Select one approved photo from the signed-in Google account. Google Photos Picker opens in a separate tab/window; it cannot be embedded in AQB.

Search the selected service’s finished outcome and Photo Brief in Google Images. Google results are references only; the image owner must permit AQB commercial reuse.

Research the selected service using its Description and Photo Brief. Inspect the qualified challenger before approving a public image replacement.

Pexels remains the external candidate source. AI review should select the most realistic and service-correct image; AQB Own Photo remains preferred.

Photo Library · Folder Import

Import candidate photos from the configured AQB photo folders. Preview before staging; existing candidates and public publication remain protected.


        
Photo Replacement · Legacy 35-File Batch
Historical fixed-cohort replacement tool. Only use for the original authorized 35-image batch; preview first. New replacements should use the normal photo-review staging workflow. No automatic publication.

Admin operations
      

        
↻
Refresh Retie Schedule
Recalculate Sisterlocks retie dates and create eligible automatic appointments.


        
↻
Sync Catalogue from Master Lists
Admin-only synchronization of active Master Lists services into the AQB Catalogue. Existing Catalogue content is preserved.

        
✓
Approve Active Catalogue Services
Approve all currently active AQB Master Lists services for Catalogue processing. The count is dynamic and includes newly added services. This does not bypass the public photo/publication safety gate.

        
✓
Prepare Catalogue
Build and refresh the prepared public AQB Catalogue from active Master Lists services. Use this if the public Catalogue has not loaded or has not yet been initialized.
Ready to prepare.

        
◈
Revalidate Catalogue Photos
Validate existing catalogue photos for validity, uniqueness and publication status. This does not run photo research or trend research.

        
✓
Validate & Repair Catalogue Photos
Check active services for missing or duplicate images, including AQB-owned photos. Duplicate images are automatically replaced when a suitable unique photo is available.

        
↗
Sync Calendar Access
Refresh shared Calendar access for active AQB users and appointment events.
↻
Sync Appointments with Live Calendar
Refresh future AQB appointment events from the Appointments sheet into the connected Google Calendar.
